description: Create one short link the user opens to connect the services you name, with one button per service. Use the ids from check_setup's `missingProviders`, plus `cloudflare` if it is not connected. You cannot create a connection yourself, and must never ask the user to paste a secret into the chat: give them this link instead. Then poll check_setup with the returned sessionId and continue once `connectionRequest.complete` is true. Returns sessionId, connectUrl and expiresAt.
